description: Registry defining the constituent constraint families of the Admissibility Predicate (P_adm).
logical_form: P_adm = Gamma_E AND Gamma_R AND Gamma_T AND Gamma_O

families.name: Mismatch Preservation
families.description: Ensures that the transition maintains active distinction and satisfies context mismatch thresholds.

families.name: Residue Compatibility
families.description: Ensures that the transition satisfies constraints established by the established relational trace (Principle 2.X).

families.name: Topology Compatibility
families.formal_definition: Gamma_T(x', c, R, -(i)) = 1 iff T(x') is compatible with A_adm(t)
families.description: Ensures that the transition produces an organization belonging to an admissible topological class (e.g. knot/braid selection).

families.name: Orientation Compatibility
families.description: Ensures the transition is directionally compatible with the current orientation reference frame.

governance.note: Separates abstract boolean check from mechanism-specific realization.
